title: Developer tools
diceReady: The next random dice result is set.
invalidCommand: A command must be a JSON object.
mapLinkInvalid: That map link could not be read, so the classic island is open instead.
mapHintTerrain: Tap a hex to paint it. Keys 1–9 pick a terrain.
mapHintToken: Tap a land hex to step its number up; hold Shift to step down.
mapHintHarbor: Tap a coastal edge to place the harbor; tap again to remove it.
mapHintErase: Tap a hex to clear it back to open sea.
mapHintRobber: Tap a land hex where the robber starts.
mapHintPirate: Tap a sea hex where the pirate starts; tap it again to keep the pirate off the board.
mapHintSetup: Tap land hexes to mark where the first settlements may go. None marked means anywhere.
mapTokensUnsolved: No balanced numbering fits this map. Try moving a few hexes.
mapSaveFailed: The map could not be saved on this device.
mapCheckClean: No problems and nothing to improve.
mapProblemNoLand: Paint some land to start a map.
mapProblemTerrainNeedsSeafaring_one: {{count}} sea, gold or fog hex needs Seafaring (turn it on under Rules).
mapProblemTerrainNeedsSeafaring_other: {{count}} sea, gold or fog hexes need Seafaring (turn it on under Rules).
mapProblemTokenOnTokenless_one: {{count}} desert or water hex carries a number.
mapProblemTokenOnTokenless_other: {{count}} desert or water hexes carry a number.
mapProblemTooManyOfNumber: {{count}} hexes show a {{number}}; at most {{limit}} may.
mapProblemUnreachableLand_one: {{count}} land hex can never be reached from where players start.
mapProblemUnreachableLand_other: {{count}} land hexes can never be reached from where players start.
mapProblemHarborNotCoastal_one: {{count}} harbor is not on a coast.
mapProblemHarborNotCoastal_other: {{count}} harbors are not on a coast.
mapProblemHarborSharedWater_one: {{count}} harbor faces the same water hex as another.
mapProblemHarborSharedWater_other: {{count}} harbors face the same water hex as another.
mapProblemHarborSharedVertex_one: {{count}} harbor shares a corner with another.
mapProblemHarborSharedVertex_other: {{count}} harbors share a corner with another.
mapProblemHarborDuplicate: Two harbors sit on the same edge.
mapProblemRobberMissing: Place the robber on a land hex.
mapProblemRobberNotLand: The robber must start on land.
mapProblemPirateNotSea: The pirate must start on a sea hex.
mapProblemSetupTooSmall: Only {{spots}} starting settlements fit; {{needed}} are needed.
mapProblemFogStackMismatch: The fog stack holds {{tiles}} tiles for {{hexes}} fog hexes.
mapProblemFogTokensMismatch: The fog stack holds {{tokens}} numbers; its land tiles need {{needed}}.
mapProblemFogBesideLand_one: {{count}} fog hex touches land; keep a sea hex between fog and land.
mapProblemFogBesideLand_other: {{count}} fog hexes touch land; keep a sea hex between fog and land.
mapProblemSeatsTooFew: Seafaring and Cities & Knights maps need at least three players.
mapProblemEngineRejected: The game cannot start on this map: {{message}}
mapProblemAdjacentRed_one: {{count}} hex has a 6 or 8 next to another 6 or 8.
mapProblemAdjacentRed_other: {{count}} hexes have a 6 or 8 next to another 6 or 8.
mapProblemAdjacentEqual_one: {{count}} hex has the same number as a neighbour.
mapProblemAdjacentEqual_other: {{count}} hexes have the same number as a neighbour.
mapProblemMissingResource: No numbered {{terrain}}, so one resource never comes up.
mapProblemRobberOnNumber: The robber starts on a numbered hex and blocks it.
mapProblemSetupTight: Room for only {{spots}} starting settlements with {{players}} players; the last to place have little choice.
mapFiveSixNote: Five and six players add their own rules automatically.
mapSetupAll: Players may start on any land.
mapSetupSome_one: Players start on the {{count}} marked hex.
mapSetupSome_other: Players start on the {{count}} marked hexes.
mapShareBlocked: Fix the problems under Check to export this map.
mapCopyFailed: Copying failed; select the text and copy it yourself.
mapLongLink: This link is long; some chat apps cut it off. The string always works.
mapImportInvalid: That is not a map string, link or map file.
mapSavedError: Saved maps could not be read.
